appearance.subtle: Their arms move a little too smoothly, and their sleeves hang oddly.
appearance.obvious: One arm is a grey muscular tentacle to the elbow, coiling and uncoiling while they talk.
appearance.extreme: Both arms are boneless tentacles, thick as thighs at the shoulder and tapering, and they are always moving. One of them is holding something behind them.

description: Your arms have lost their bones and gained a great deal else. They reach further than arms should and they do not let go.
drawbacks: No sleeve is the right shape
name: Tentacular Arms
